purpose: Local-corrections revision: exactness checks, executed-instruction counts, correction-site frequencies and per-round meter statistics of measurement/step.c with bloop_branchy.h and floop.h (generated by gen4.py from the predecessor's BLOOP_FIELD).

method.counting: QEMU 8.2.2 qemu-aarch64 user mode: -d in_asm,exec,nochain, translation-block sizes x executions, -dfilter on the harness's own functions (main..batch_step, read_fe and libc excluded); equals -one-insn-per-tb counting on the predecessor round

exactness.rare_functions_vs_predecessor_build: step_rare, rare_2cycle, rare_anchor, add_single, finv, new_trail, dp_restart: same instruction count, differences only in address immediates
exactness.a20_vs_a24_build: batch_step 2092 instructions in both; 6 differ in extr/ubfiz/and immediates only

stress_builds_identical.A=2^6,DP=6,8-bit filters,n=600: fee09a2d (315,105 two-cycles, 7,033 long, 624,219 DPs, 39,900 look-ahead DPs)

site_frequencies_B2^16_A2^16_32_rounds.note: measured with weight-1 single-site builds of the same site code; events per site and seed about 2^21
site_frequencies_B2^16_A2^16_32_rounds.fd_x3b: fd and x3b borrow with probability 1 - mean x(R)/p and mean x(R)/p over the 2^16-adder table; their sum is within 0.1% of the event count
